text:
flo: RFC follow-up: need a concise operator cutover checklist for moving customers off shared-peering into per-tenant ephemeral relays. must preserve client src IP when feasible, avoid lease exhaustion on spikes, and provide a fast rollback path. pasteable commands please.

emily: +1. keep it reversible and require audit ticket on every op. preflight should check SNAT prefs and long-lived sessions.

raj: high-level steps I propose: 1) preflight 2) reserve leases 3) create+cert-wait for relay 4) warm probes 5) shadow small % 6) promote with sticky leases (ttl configurable) 7) reclaim. reversible at each step.

raj: preflight command:
```bash
opsctl customer preflight --customer=cust-888 --fields=snat,active_sessions,lease_usage --ticket=INC-2026-8888
```

emily: reserve leases example:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://ops.internal/egress/v1/leases -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" -d '{"customer":"cust-888","count":20,"region":"us-west-2","purpose":"cutover-2026-03"}'
```

raj: create relay + cert wait + probe:
```bash
opsctl relay create --name=rel-usw2-33 --region=us-west-2 --customer=cust-888 --ticket=INC-2026-8888
opsctl relay cert-wait --relay=rel-usw2-33 --timeout=120 --ticket=INC-2026-8888
opsctl relay probe --relay=rel-usw2-33 --shots=100 --ticket=INC-2026-8888
```

mira: shadow/promote commands and notes:
- shadow = sample 2-5% for 10m
- monitor egress.lease_pool_available, relay.health, cp.request_latency, tcp.session_abort_rate
```bash
opsctl route modify --customer=cust-888 --target=rel-usw2-33 --sample=3 --ticket=INC-2026-8888
# once stable
opsctl route promote --customer=cust-888 --target=rel-usw2-33 --sticky-ttl=1800 --ticket=INC-2026-8888
```

flo: sticky-ttl guidance: default 600s for request/response; 1800s for websocket-like flows but require lease-refresh support. relay -> operator refresh example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/egress/v1/leases/refresh -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELAY_TOKEN" -d '{"lease_id":"lease-zzz","extend_seconds":1800}'
```

emily: autoscale & backpressure rules: if egress.lease_pool_available < 12% -> run autoscale hook AND reduce sampling immediately by 50%. eviction policy: evict non-sticky short-TTL leases first. add metric alert lease_pool_available < 12%.

ops-bot: ALERT: lease_pool_available for cust-888 at 11% (threshold 12%). INCIDENT INC-2026-8888 created and assigned to raj.

raj: fast rollback (one-liner):
```bash
opsctl route rollback --customer=cust-888 --to=shared-peering --ticket=INC-2026-8888
```

raj: if exhaustion persists, scale controllers and add more reserved leases:
```bash
kubectl -n infra scale deployment/egress-operator --replicas=$(($(kubectl get deploy egress-operator -o jsonpath='{.status.availableReplicas}')+2))
curl -s -X POST https://ops.internal/egress/v1/leases -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" -d '{"customer":"cust-888","count":30,"region":"us-west-2"}'
```

mira: audit: append --ticket=INC-2026-8888 or -H "X-Audit-Ticket: INC-2026-8888" to all commands and record route ids in customer timeline.

flo: action items: raj -> add lease-refresh endpoint + tests; emily -> add preflight validator; mira -> add autoscale binding and eviction rule. i'll draft the cutover playbook and attach these commands to the RFC. keep replies short. :thumbsup:
